description: On a narrow mountain road on a sunny summer day, a rusty old flatbed truck carries a huge, top-heavy stack of hay bales tied with rope, piled far higher and wider than the truck itself. The truck stands at the edge of a low stone wall above a steep drop, and as the view moves around it, the load leans out over the drop and the front wheel hangs over the edge. A small stone roadside shrine with a wooden cross stands in the wildflowers in front, and green valleys and blue mountains stretch away behind.
